collection.title: Daihatsu Cuore 1997 to 2004 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Daihatsu Cuore 1997 - 2003 model which requires a 18" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 15" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
